note: Set A contains specific engineering errors, such as attributing a 10-inch depth to a C3X6 channel (which is nominally 3 inches deep) and claiming a W10X15 member is in Detail C2 (which shows W10X12). Set A also suffers from significant redundancy. Set B correctly identifies members in their respective details (e.g., W8X10 in A1, W10X12 in Duct Framing) and captures unique plate specifications in C1 without obvious misbindings.
